text:
marta: heads-up — we need to finalize where routing policy headers get applied in the SDKs. console rollout needs client-side propagation for canary routing. who owns this behavior?

alex: my take: prefer server-side canonicalization, but SDKs should offer an opt-in header to accelerate rollouts. risk: older clients may drop unknown headers and we’ll lose the hint. ping @jay for past break context.

jay: we hit this before when we renamed a header last quarter — a small percentage of clients silently dropped it and routing went to default pool. i vote for an SDK shim + gateway fallback so older clients keep working.

marta: gateway fallback sounds safe. we also need visibility when the shim is used vs gateway fallback — otherwise rollout metrics are useless. can SDKs emit a telemetry event?

sam: propose: SDK adds header `x-rwd-route-v2` when feature-flagged. telemetry: emit `routehint_emitted` with a sampled boolean and SDK version. keep the change minimal in each client lib.

alex: example TS patch I had in mind:
```ts
// add routehint if opt-in is true
if (opts.routeHint) {
  headers['x-rwd-route-v2'] = `policy=${opts.routeHint.policy};shard=${opts.routeHint.shard}`
}
```

jay: TS looks fine. python’s http libs sometimes normalize headers to lower-case or drop unknown ones in some proxies. maybe consolidate to a single header key that servers can parse both v1 and v2 values, e.g. `x-rwd-route` with versioned payload.

marta: we must avoid parsing breaks server-side. what if we use `x-rwd-route` and encode `v=2;policy=...`? servers accept existing key and can fallback to legacy parsing.

sam: that’s workable. console also needs to show: percent of requests with `v=2` vs requests where gateway applied fallback. need new telemetry dims: `route_version` and `route_emitted_by`.

alex: rollout plan idea:
- week 0: SDK opt-in patch (minor semver) for TS/Go/python micropatch
- week 1: server accepts `x-rwd-route` v1 and v2 formats, add deprecation logs when v1 parsed
- week 2: enable canary via console for 5% clients, monitor `routehint_emitted` events
- week 4: expand, then remove shim after 90 days

jay: semver note: TS/Go can be minor since opt-in. python may require micro release due to packaging cadence. document deprecations clearly in changelog and SDK migration guide.

infra-bot: deploy-bot queued canary rollout job INF-2741 (canary-gateway) and ENG-4830 (sdk-ts-pr) for 03/25 02:00 UTC.

marta: assigning action items: @alex implement TS/Go PRs, @sam map telemetry & console dashboard changes, @jay add python shim + changelog. i'll update rollout doc and set canary watch thresholds. thanks :thumbsup:
